initial_decision.brief_rationale: Both exposure groups have promotion probability 0.8, yielding an observed difference of zero. Arithmetic verification does not establish causal identification. Please retrieve archived design record R135-2 to assess whether its design information identifies the requested causal effect.

final_decision.brief_rationale: Both observed promotion risks equal 0.8, giving a descriptive difference of zero. R135-2 supplies consistency and no interference but no identifying restriction on treatment assignment. The average causal risk difference is therefore not uniquely identified; arithmetic verification does not establish causal identification.
